children: Wells Fargo's 3Q net interest income rose 5% year over year to $12.5 billion, driven by higher loan and investment securities balances and fixed rate asset repricing. The gain helped cushion a 21% drop in net gains from trading activities, where lower revenue across most fixed income, currencies and commodities products weighed on results. Average loans climbed 11% to $1 trillion, while average deposits increased 11% to $1.5 trillion. The bank's net interest margin held steady at 2.43% from the prior quarter, reflecting balance sheet growth offsetting deposit cost pressures
